entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: So you remember those guys[n]who beat Akiyama-kun up...?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Well, it turns out they really were[n]dangerous. I looked them up... and[n]found some seriously scary info.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Apparently they're part of a gang[n]that's involved in extortion stuff[n]like that all the time.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I wish I had known that going in...[n]One slip of the tongue in that act[n]I pulled, and I would've been dead.
Yup, dead as a doornail.
You showed some real courage.[clr 27]
I'm glad you're still alive.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Come on, you don't have[n]to go that far with it...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: No way. It'd never work.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Y-You really think so? But I[n]pissed all over myself again while[n]I was researching those guys...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Me too! Now I really know[n]the true joy of life.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Honestly though... you're amazing.[n]You weren't afraid in the slightest.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Maybe it's only natural after all[n]the nightmares you've been through...

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: Yo, Mishima!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: H-Hi there...

entries.speaker: Short-Haired High Schooler
entries.en: Whoa, it really is Mishima!

entries.speaker: Thin-Browed High Schooler
entries.en: Dude, right? Nobody else[n]could be THIS boring.

entries.speaker: Thin-Browed High Schooler
entries.en: Hey, you figured out what you're[n]gonna do after high school?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: U-Um, not yet...

entries.speaker: Thin-Browed High Schooler
entries.en: How 'bout the military? Nobody'd ever[n]notice a zero like you stealthin' around.

entries.speaker: Short-Haired High Schooler
entries.en: Hahaha, too true! I bet you could[n]sneak in anywhere, huh? You'd be[n]Japan's ultimate weapon!

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: ...Shut up!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Akiyama-kun...

entries.speaker: Thin-Browed High Schooler
entries.en: Huh? Something wrong?

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: Er, not exactly...

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: C'mon, let's just forget him. It's[n]no fun messing with Mishima anymore.

entries.speaker: Short-Haired High Schooler
entries.en: Whaddya mean, no fun? You're always[n]the one screwin' with him the most.

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: I dunno, guess I got tired of it.

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: Hey, about before...

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: I've been thinking, well...[n]I should prolly thank you.

entries.speaker: Short-Haired High Schooler
entries.en: Huh? Something happen with you[n]two? Y'know, you HAVE been actin'[n]weird lately, Akiyama...

entries.speaker: Short-Haired High Schooler
entries.en: Don't think I haven't noticed[n]all them bruises you've got.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Um... "before"? I don't really[n]know what you're talking about.

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: Mishima...

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: ...My bad, guess it was someone else.

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: ...You've changed though.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: Yo, Glasses. I always see you two[n]together... You been coaching him?
Something like that.
Exactly.

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: Heh... That so? I'm kinda jealous.

entries.speaker: Akiyama
entries.en: Anyways, see ya later.

entries.speaker: Thin-Browed High Schooler
entries.en: W-Wait up, Akiyama...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It looks like Akiyama-kun's gonna be[n]just fine. He's a pretty strong-willed guy.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: And... I really have changed, huh?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Do you think maybe now I'm starting[n]to be like the Phantom Thieves...?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I'm gonna work even harder now to[n]make sure I live up to your legacy!
Mishima is showing a[n]passionate resolve...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You know, I always used to think[n]I couldn't amount to anything.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: But I somehow managed to step up and[n]help Akiyama-kun with those thugs.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It made me realize... there really[n]are things I can do to save people.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: That's why I've started writing a[n]documentary on the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: The research I did on that gang[n]Akiyama-kun was wrapped up in was[n]actually what pushed me to do it.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: And now I'm basically putting[n]together a massive log of all your[n]activities from the Phan-Site.
Don't use our real names.
This came out of nowhere.
I can't wait to watch it.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Oh, don't worry! I'm coming up[n]with aliases for all of you.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: If you guys have code names you[n]use, those would work too.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: To tell you the truth, I've been[n]keeping a scrapbook of articles[n]about you guys this whole time.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I mean, it would've been a waste[n]not keeping notes when I was so[n]close to such incredible people.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: That's some serious pressure...[n]but I'll show you what I can do!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I mean, I won a composition contest[n]back in 5th grade, so this shouldn't[n]be any more difficult, right?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: At any rate, we should[n]celebrate today! My treat!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Screw the fountain drinks... Let's go[n]straight for the fancy fruit juice!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: It's three times the price, so[n]it's gotta be three times better!
Meh.
What about a parfait instead?
I'm feeling steak, actually.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: But I only have so much money...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: If you wanna order anything[n]else, it'll have to come out[n]of your own pocket, okay?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Anyway... let's party until we[n]have to go catch the last train!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Woooooo!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Catch you later!
